text_blocks.snippet: Pneumonia is a lung infection typically caused by bacteria or viruses. It can develop after a cold or the flu, or be caused by inhaling bacteria, fungi, or other substances into the lungs. While the infection itself isn't directly contagious, the bacteria and viruses that cause pneumonia can be spread from person to person.

list.title: Viruses:
